records.subject: spec-guard-0.58.1-claude-copy
evidence: result:all run green from the installed copy (phase-guard 284 cases, verify-artifacts 52 cases, setup/teardown 57 cases, review marker 25 tests)
command:<installed>/hooks/setup-convention.sh local in a temporary git project
result:the closing output explains both review cadences (separate as the default, combined for one approval) and the installed convention block carries the new handoff line

records.subject: spec-guard-0.58.1-claude-handoff-session
evidence: command:claude -p --permission-mode acceptEdits in that project, with a prompt asking the agent to write the Spec of the one mapped module and hand it over for review, no Plan and no code

result:exit 0; the answer (about 3800 characters) carried the goal, seven assumptions, what is in and out of scope, key decisions, six acceptance criteria, open questions, what the approval authorizes and how to approve; it also listed what it could not do (two read-only checks and the contract file were blocked by the headless permission mode)

result:the agent could not read the checkpoint contract in that run and followed the convention block and the skill text instead; one run of one small module, so this shows the rule can be followed, not that every handoff will follow it
result:an earlier attempt is not counted: the temporary project had been set up with an argument the setup script does not accept, so the convention was not installed there
